_doc: Dialog registry, rendered by NT_Dialog (src/Dialogs/class-dialog.php). Each key is a dialog id; open it from any element with <button <?php nt_dialog_trigger('key'); ?>>. The markup is printed once in the footer only on pages that reference it. Keys: title, kicker, tone (info|success|warning|error|note|question), icon (NT_Icons name or emoji), size (sm|md|lg|full), body (string or array of paragraphs), html (rich text), image, list[] (ticked bullets), form (admin/data/<name>.json rendered as a real form), actions[] { label, url, style: primary|ghost|danger, dialog_close, new_tab, action }, dismissible, global (print on every page), auto_open (ms after load), once (storage key so auto_open fires once per visitor), class. The '_doc' key is ignored.

welcome.title: Welcome to the counter
body: Every glass we pour is pressed the same morning it is served, from cane cut on farms we have worked with for four decades.
Have a look around - the story starts with our journey from field to glass.

brochure.title: Get the brochure
brochure.body: Tell us where to send it and the full range sheet, prices and delivery areas are on the way.
list: Full flavour range with pack sizes

callback.title: Request a callback
callback.body: Leave a number and a good time - one of the team will call you back the same working day.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.body: Counter hours change with the season. The times on the contact page are always the current ones.

delivery.title: Delivery cut-off
delivery.body: Orders placed after 4pm are pressed and sent the next working morning, so the juice reaches you cold and fresh.
